name: sheetcheck-demo
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Five rows of made-up ink maps, each shown one sheet in, on the sheet and one sheet out, with a verdict bar: the top row, where each sheet has its own strokes, has a green bar; the rows smeared across sheets, with a shared texture, with a bright band along the mask edge and with a bright diagonal crack have red bars.
caption: Synthetic demo: kit sheetcheck demo on made-up sheets of random strokes. Only the sharp map passes; maps smeared across sheets, sharing a texture, following the mask edge or lit in a crack fail. No scan data.
